claims.claim_text: The entity discloses information about the governance body(ies) or individual(s) responsible for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities, including climate-related risks and opportunities, and how those responsibilities are reflected in applicable terms of reference, mandates, role descriptions and related policies.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities
claims.support_notes: Text states a generic disclosure expectation but does not identify the specific governance body/individuals or cite actual terms of reference/mandates/policies.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how the governance body(ies) or individual(s) determine whether appropriate skills and competencies are available (or will be developed) to oversee strategies designed to respond to sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities (bullet: skills and competencies)
claims.support_notes: No description of the process for assessing/developing skills or competencies is provided.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how and how often the governance body(ies) or individual(s) are informed about sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities, including how and how often such information is provided.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities (bullet: informed/how often)
claims.support_notes: No frequency, channels, reporting cadence, or examples of information provided are included.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how the governance body(ies) or individual(s) take sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities into account when overseeing the entity’s strategy, decisions on major transactions, and risk management processes and related policies, including consideration of trade-offs.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities (bullet: strategy/transactions/risk management/trade-offs)
claims.support_notes: No concrete governance practices, examples of major transactions, risk management integration, or trade-off considerations are described.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how the governance body(ies) or individual(s) oversee the setting of targets related to sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities and monitor progress towards those targets, including whether and how related performance metrics are included in remuneration policies.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities (bullet: targets/monitoring/remuneration)
claims.support_notes: No targets, monitoring approach, metrics, or remuneration linkages are actually disclosed.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses management’s role in the governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Section lists what should be disclosed but does not describe the actual management role, processes, controls, or procedures.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses whether management’s role is delegated to a specific management-level position or management-level committee, and how oversight is exercised over that position or committee.
claims.support_notes: No named position/committee or oversight mechanism is provided.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses whether management uses controls and procedures to support oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities and, if so, how those controls and procedures are integrated with other internal functions.
claims.support_notes: No controls/procedures or integration details (e.g., risk, finance, audit, compliance) are described.
